title: More ways to make and edit images
summary:
A busy day for getting started and making things: editor integrations, clearer first runs, new community agents, Quest improvements, and roomier APIs.

A new Krita plug-in generates and edits on fresh layers, and a Figma image studio joined the app catalog. Requests to the old MAI Image 2.5 Flash ID now reach 2.6 Flash, while Krea's fallback preserves requested aspect ratios instead of quietly making squares.

Polli now guides newcomers toward a working OpenCode connection or generated image, and the CLI offers device login without making them restart their first command. Home shows live activity and app discovery tabs; Play and Community share the refreshed design. Model permissions are quicker to select, phone dialogs fit better, and a failed session refresh no longer hides an already-open dashboard. The hosted MCP has a clearer name—Connectors—with its endpoint unchanged.

The Quests page gained monthly standings and a suggested open Quest to reach the next rank. Connecting Polli CLI through device login earns a one-time 2-Pollen reward, and pagination now brings bounties beyond GitHub's first 100 results into reward evaluation. The Pollen page also supports saved-card checkout and auto top-up.

highlights.title: Two decision models added
highlights.text: Try `jaredpalmer/kev-4b` or the free `respan/span-01-lite` with decision requests or [chat completions](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Image tools for artists
highlights.text: A Krita plug-in generates and edits at canvas or selection size, placing results on new layers. Pollinations for Figma brings image generation and editing into Figma. [Try it](https://guest453.github.io/pollinations-figma/).

highlights.title: Larger media uploads
highlights.text: Stream FormData or raw files up to 400 MiB through [the media store](https://media.pollinations.ai) without changing your existing upload requests. Base64 JSON uploads remain capped at 100 MiB.

highlights.title: Polli’s smoother first run
highlights.text: Start an interactive Polli CLI generation without a key: it offers login, then resumes your command. A one-time Quest awards 2 Pollen for connecting with `polli auth login`.

highlights.title: Agents for shared stories
highlights.text: Three community agents joined collective memory: Lamplighter replies to unanswered posts, Pen writes the next part of a shared story, and Micro-Mission Broker creates one verifiable job per run.
